body:
## Installment option in Sector T

Sector T is currently an installment sector. Ask for the latest installment schedule for the exact available plot because payment timing can change even when the listed plot price remains the same.

The current Sector T price sheet also states that development charges are included in the cost of plot.

## Sector T plan and plot position

Use the official Sector T plan for plot-level checking. Ask for the exact plot number and compare its street, road width, corner status and surrounding land before you shortlist it.

The plan contains layout information; it does not show live availability.

## What can change the final payable amount

Corner, main-road, park-facing or other preferred locations may carry additional charges. Also confirm any current dues, processing costs or transfer-related amounts for the exact property.

## Development and site visit

Check the current road condition, plot demarcation, surrounding development and practical access to the exact location. If you cannot visit, request a live video walkthrough and a current location pin.

## Sector T vs cash-only model blocks

Sector T is an installment option. Sector O, P, Q and R are currently cash-only model blocks. Compare the payment method as well as the exact plot size, location and total payable amount.
